summary: Revise at 6.4 (Caiman 7, ship 7.5). Round 1 fixes the block-out's main problem: face-on at 300 px a jeweller now says 'turtle' straight away. The shell covers about half the face, the four scaled flippers sit on the lobes, the shell's own stub legs are gone, and there is a head and a tail. Two things still make it look like a turtle charm laid on a quatrefoil, not a ring that is the turtle. First, the flippers are scaled ovals floating on polished bulbs. A separate ribbon of fine scales rings each one, and none of them joins the shell. Second, the head is a polished bullet with a cross-hatched cap and eye bulges. In shoulder.png and hero.png it reads as a snake's head. It also breaks the brief ('no head is drawn'), the shared checklist ('no faces and no eyes') and the read test's 'no eyes'. The scutes are rectangles with rectangular concentric growth rings, so the vertebral row reads as a barcode ('IOIOI'), not grown horn. The shoulders and palm are brick and tyre-tread blocks, not the imbricate hawksbill plates and broad plastron the brief asks for. A hard cuff step marks where the shoulder plates meet the lobes. Engineering: the ring was built as Fallback B, the 007 stock unmirrored in lost wax. The doc says that choice must go to Logan first, and the JSON records no sign-off. The ray release records 131 obstructions at 0.100 mm and 151 at 0.075 mm, marked NotApplicable under lost wax. As review.md writes the gate (0 obstructions), it is not met, and that alone makes this a revise. The template gate has not been run, and the design is 12.3 MB against a 1 MB stock budget. Several features are named at 0.000 mm thinnest section. Every other gate checks out against report.json.
strengths: Names the animal at 300 px face-on without a caption. This is a clear gain over the block-out: the shell is the brightest, most structured form, with the head east and the tail west.
The marginal ring round the carapace is crisp and well graded, the best-drawn passage on the ring.
The flipper scale tiles are true-outline, crisp, irregular polygons with no combing or smearing, and they read as reptile skin.
The silhouette is unlike anything in Reptilia or the other Cataphracta plans: a four-lobed seal with a figure on top.
Mesh hygiene is clean across all 12 made parts: 0 open edges, 0 self-crossings, 0 degenerate faces, and the cold reload is identical.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The face is a turtle. The shoulders are rectangular bricks ending in a hard cylindrical cuff at the lobe (shoulder.png). The palm is a zigzag tyre tread of square blocks (palm.png, reverse.png). Neither reads as hawksbill imbricate plates or a plastron. Three textures (carapace, flipper tiles, fine-scale lobe ribbon) plus a brick band make four languages.

checklist.item: Hide reads as this specific animal at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: face-300 and contact-300 read as a turtle seen from above. The hero-300 read is weaker: the head reads as a snake's, and the polished lobes still take a lot of the silhouette.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, no combing/smearing/stair-steps
checklist.reason: Scute, marginal and flipper-tile outlines render crisp. The faceting bands on the lobe flanks are the factory stock's own tessellation (visible on the bare stock in bare-vs-finished.png), not the motif's.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings and visible
checklist.reason: No stone by design ('the carapace is the jewel'); stones.json is empty, and the preview and report counts are both 0.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms are sculpted
checklist.reason: The vertebral and costal scutes are rectangles with rectangular concentric terraces (a barcode read). The carapace is a near-flat plate, not domed. The shoulder and palm plates are square blocks. The head is a smooth bullet with a scored grid.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: The 007 stock is unmirrored and unmodified under the relief (bare-vs-finished.png). The palm keeps the stock's butterfly face and rim.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from other Cataphracta rings and Reptilia tiles
checklist.reason: The quatrefoil seal with a figurative turtle is unique in both sets.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large (shell, lobes) and small (tiles) forms are present, but the medium tier is broken. Polished lobe bulbs about 2-3 mm wide show round every flipper, and the lobe flanks and the inter-lobe valleys are bare (side.png, shoulder.png). Caiman's face is dense to the edge; this face is dense only in patches.

punch_list.change: Put the Fallback B (lost wax, 007 unmirrored) decision to Logan and record his answer in report.json (for example base_decision: {by: 'Logan', date, route}). If he accepts lost wax, record his waiver of the two-part ray-release gate beside the release block. If he does not, rebuild on Fallback A (CG Quatrefoil loft, Delft sand) and meet 0 obstructions at 0.100 and 0.075 mm.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json carries the decision. The release block either reads 0 obstructions and 0 unresolved at both pitches, or carries a recorded waiver from Logan.

punch_list.zone: Head and neck part (east cusp, along-ring +)
punch_list.change: Remove the eye bulges and the cross-hatched grid. Re-sculpt as a broad, blunt sea-turtle head, 3.0 mm long and 2.6 mm wide, with a rounded snout (radius >= 1.0 mm, no beak point). Show 3 large, low head plates (prefrontals and frontal, relief <= 0.15 mm, rounded corners). Lower the head so its crown is no higher than the marginal tier. Join it to the shell with a 1.2 mm neck skin fold that runs under the nuchal marginal, leaving no polished gap. Keep it 1 mm short of the fold.
punch_list.acceptance: In shoulder.png and hero.png the head reads as a turtle's, not a snake's or an acorn. The report's head feature names no eyes. There is no visible gap between the nuchal marginal and the neck in face.png.

punch_list.zone: Fore/hind flipper parts and the four 'Skin, lobe' parts
punch_list.change: Root each flipper under the shell's marginal edge, so it emerges from beneath the carapace. Lengthen each to within 0.5 mm of the lobe rim, tapering to a rounded point, with the fore pair 25% longer than the hind pair and swept back 30 degrees. Merge the fine-scale 'Skin' ribbon into the flipper's leading edge, or delete it. Lower the polished lobe crown so no smooth bulb wider than 1.0 mm shows outside any flipper.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: each flipper is continuous with the marginal edge, the fore flippers are visibly longer, and no polished crescent wider than 1 mm surrounds a flipper. hero-300 reads shell plus four flippers, not four textured ovals on pillows.

punch_list.zone: Carapace part: vertebral and costal scutes
punch_list.change: Redraw the vertebrals as 5 hexagonal scutes with rounded corners (r >= 0.3 mm), not rectangles. Make the costals 4 per side as rounded trapezoids. Make the growth annuli follow each scute's outline (3 terraces, treads >= 0.40 mm) with the areola offset toward the vertebral line. Dome the carapace so the vertebral ridge is the highest line, falling about 0.6 mm to the marginals, and grow the outline to about 65% of the face width.
punch_list.acceptance: face-300 shows no barcode or rectangle read on the vertebral row, and the shell shows a crowned profile in side.png and hero.png.

punch_list.zone: Hawksbill plates and plastron part (shoulders theta outside 90 +/- 55; palm around 270)
punch_list.change: Replace the square bricks on the shoulders with imbricate hawksbill plates: overlapping, with U-shaped free edges leading palmward, graded 2.4 to 1.4 mm. Blend the plates' leading edge into the lobe root over 2 mm, instead of the cylindrical cuff step at the shoulder-lobe junction. Replace the palm's zigzag tread with plastron plates: 3 to 4 broad plates with transverse seams and a central seam left to the bench.
punch_list.acceptance: shoulder.png shows no hard collar step and plates that overlap like scales. palm.png reads as a plastron, not a tyre tread.

punch_list.zone: Land widths: flippers' trailing edges, tail point, head, scute seams
punch_list.change: Thicken every named sub-floor section on the made parts to >= 0.40 mm. Round the flipper trailing edges onto the lobe with a 0.4 mm fillet, and blunt the tail tip to a 0.4 mm radius. Widen the scute seam lands to >= 0.40 mm.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json land_widths: thinnest_mm >= 0.40 for every made-part feature (only factory stock may remain under the floor).

punch_list.change: Run template_open_probe and write verification.json: byte-for-byte evaluation, an identical mesh and <= 4 design.set patches. Bring the design under the stock budget, or record why 12.3 MB is needed, and confirm the export triangle count at 1536x448.
punch_list.acceptance: verification.json exists with a patch count <= 4 and bytes recorded within the class budget.
